lines.text: Many learners say: She said that she is tired.
Better: She said that she was tired.
Was! He said that he was happy.

data.wrong: She said that she is tired.
data.right: She said that she was tired.

native.tip: После said ставь “was”: “She said that she was tired.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “She said that she is tired”? 😅 По-русски время в такой фразе не меняется, а в английском после said нужно “was.” Правильно: “She said that she was tired.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “was.” После said нужно was. Скажи вслух: “She said that she was tired.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: After said, use “was”: “She said that she was tired.”
en.caption: Do you also say “She said that she is tired”? 😅 In Russian the time stays as in the speaker's own words, but in English you need “was” after said. Correct: “She said that she was tired.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
